title: [Master] - Bug 651041: [Sustainability][Value Chain] Item Reclassification Journal forces a non-zero Total CO2e and adds it to the item's footprint under Average carbon tracking
summary: Item Reclassification Journals are now exempt from the sustainability check that requires a non-zero CO2e value, so a stock move can post with zero Total CO2e and no longer adds emissions to the item's footprint. Other item journals keep the existing validation.
key_points: Reclassification journals are exempted from the non-zero CO2e validation that applies to other item journals
The reclassification source indicator is passed to sustainability posting validation to enable differential handling
Other item journals maintain existing non-zero CO2e checks for non-renewable-energy subcategories
Transfer Sustainability Value Entries correctly record zero CO2e amounts for reclassification moves
Test coverage added for posting reclassification with zero Total CO2e
